name: desktop
description: 基于本地 AI 的智能虚拟文件管理系统。支持跨媒体元数据自动提取、多维度分类与虚拟目录管理。深度优化压缩包（如漫画归档）管理，告别文件混乱，实现一键智能化整理。

scripts.setup-resources: node pro/scripts/run.js setup-extra-resources.js && node pro/scripts/run.js copy-viewer-resources.js
scripts.start:debug: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm setup-resources && cross-env DEVTOOLS=true LOG_LEVEL=debug,info,warn,error BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite dev -- --log-categories=ALL,-LLAMA_SERVER
scripts.start:canary: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm setup-resources && cross-env NODE_ENV=production LOG_LEVEL=debug,info,warn,error BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite dev --mode canary -- --log-categories=ALL
scripts.start:prod: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm setup-resources && cross-env NODE_ENV=production LOG_LEVEL=debug,info,warn,error BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite dev --mode production -- --log-categories=ALL
scripts.start:record: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm setup-resources && cross-env WINDOW_WIDTH=1920 WINDOW_HEIGHT=1080 LOG_LEVEL=debug,info,warn,error BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite dev --mode development -- --log-categories=ALL
scripts.start:debug:no-restart: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm setup-resources && cross-env NO_MAIN_RESTART=true LOG_LEVEL=debug,info,warn,error BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite dev -- --log-categories=ALL,-LLAMA_SERVER
scripts.start:debug-posthog: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm setup-resources && cross-env ENABLE_POSTHOG=true LOG_LEVEL=debug,info,warn,error BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite dev -- --log-categories=ALL,-LLAMA_SERVER
scripts.start:info: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm setup-resources && cross-env LOG_LEVEL=info,warn,error BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite dev -- --log-categories=ALL,-LLAMA_SERVER
scripts.start:llama: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm setup-resources && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp LOG_LEVEL=debug,info,warn,error BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite dev -- --log-categories=ALL
scripts.start:llamafile: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llamafile pnpm setup-resources && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llamafile LOG_LEVEL=debug,info,warn,error BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite dev -- --log-categories=ALL
scripts.package: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp BUILD_REGION=CN node pro/scripts/run.js fix-pnpm-modules.js && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp BUILD_REGION=CN pnpm run build:prebuild && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp BUILD_REGION=CN node pro/scripts/run.js patch-product-name.js patch && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp BUILD_REGION=CN electron-vite build && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp BUILD_REGION=CN electron-forge package && cross-env BUILD_REGION=CN node pro/scripts/run.js patch-product-name.js restore
scripts.make: cross-env BUILD_REGION=CN AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node pro/scripts/run.js download-llama-cpp-releases.js && cross-env BUILD_REGION=CN AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node pro/scripts/run.js wait-for-download.js && cross-env BUILD_REGION=CN AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node pro/scripts/run.js make-installers.js
scripts.make:intl: cross-env BUILD_REGION=INTL AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node pro/scripts/run.js download-llama-cpp-releases.js && cross-env BUILD_REGION=INTL AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node pro/scripts/run.js wait-for-download.js && cross-env BUILD_REGION=INTL AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node pro/scripts/run.js make-installers.js
scripts.make:llamafile: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llamafile node pro/scripts/run.js download-llama-cpp-releases.js && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llamafile node pro/scripts/run.js wait-for-download.js && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llamafile node pro/scripts/run.js make-installers.js
scripts.publish: pnpm run build:prebuild && node pro/scripts/run.js patch-product-name.js patch && electron-vite build && node pro/scripts/run.js wait-for-download.js && electron-forge publish && node pro/scripts/run.js patch-product-name.js restore
scripts.test: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm build:prebuild && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node ../../scripts/test-electron.js run
scripts.test:electron: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm build:prebuild && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node ../../scripts/test-electron.js run
scripts.test:unit: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm build:prebuild && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node ../../scripts/test-electron.js run tests/unit
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm build:prebuild && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node ../../scripts/test-electron.js run tests/e2e
scripts.test:coverage: cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp pnpm build:prebuild && cross-env AI_ENGINE=llama.cpp node ../../scripts/test-electron.js run --coverage
scripts.build:sync: pnpm run build:prebuild && electron-vite build && (robocopy out_build out\firefly-ai-folder-win32-x64\resources\app\out_build /E /IS /IT /NC /NS /NP /NFL /NDL || exit 0)
scripts.build:prebuild: node pro/scripts/run.js prebuild-setup.js && node pro/scripts/run.js copy-viewer-resources.js
scripts.build:package: pnpm run build:prebuild && node pro/scripts/run.js patch-product-name.js patch && pnpm run build && electron-forge package && node pro/scripts/run.js patch-product-name.js restore
scripts.build:dist: pnpm run build:prebuild && electron-vite build && node pro/scripts/run.js ci-build-forge.js
scripts.build:dist:win: pnpm run build:prebuild && electron-vite build && node pro/scripts/run.js ci-build-forge.js --platform=win32
scripts.build:dist:mac: pnpm run build:prebuild && electron-vite build && node pro/scripts/run.js ci-build-forge.js --platform=darwin
scripts.build:dist:linux: pnpm run build:prebuild && electron-vite build && node pro/scripts/run.js ci-build-forge.js --platform=linux
scripts.dist: pnpm run build:prebuild && electron-vite build && node pro/scripts/run.js ci-build-forge.js
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build:prebuild && electron-vite build && node pro/scripts/run.js ci-build-forge.js --platform=win32
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build:prebuild && electron-vite build && node pro/scripts/run.js ci-build-forge.js --platform=darwin
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build:prebuild && electron-vite build && node pro/scripts/run.js ci-build-forge.js --platform=linux
scripts.build:publish: pnpm run build:prebuild && node pro/scripts/run.js patch-product-name.js patch && pnpm run build && electron-forge publish && node pro/scripts/run.js patch-product-name.js restore
